title: Convolved Numbers of $k$-sections of the Fibonacci Sequence: Properties, Consequences
summary: One possible data encryption scheme is related to stream ciphers, which use a sufficiently long pseudo-random sequence. To increase the cryptographic strength of the cipher, linear shift algorithms (generated by linear recurrent sequences such as the Fibonacci sequence and its generalizations) are additionally used.
